highlights: Updates no longer fail on ordinary Ubuntu scheduler trees, redirected legacy cleanup jobs, heredocs, NUL-bearing scripts, or inactive backup unit files.
The Dashboard updater now shows durable, real installer phases, percentage, recent milestones, reconnect state, elapsed time, and exact terminal feedback.
Update progress survives Portal restarts and page reloads, distinguishes rollback and post-commit errors, and never treats a version string alone as success.
